description: Java class 'RitaServices' providing payment processing methods for credit card authorization, capture, void, refund, and related utilities, integrating with the Rita API within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: RitaServices
classes.description: Service class providing payment processing methods for credit card transactions via Rita API within OFBiz.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization, returning transaction result details.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized credit card transaction.

methods.name: ccVoidRelease
methods.description: Voids or releases a pre-authorization or transaction.

methods.name: ccVoidRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund by voiding or releasing a transaction.

methods.name: ccCreditRefund
methods.description: Issues a credit refund for a transaction.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Handles refund logic, deciding between void or credit based on terminal state.

methods.name: setCreditCardInfo
methods.description: Sets credit card details into the Rita API object from context data.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Constructs and returns a RitaApi object configured with properties.

methods.name: buildPccProperties
methods.description: Builds properties for Rita API configuration from entity properties.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats amount from context with proper scale and rounding.
